people.imagined: Dawn on the flooded terraces before the planting. She has walked out to the edge of the top terrace in her wet green rite robe, knee-deep in mud, and has turned her head into her sleeve to cough before anyone sees. She comes up smiling anyway.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a flooded rice terrace at dawn, she has just turned her face into her sleeve to hide a cough and now lifts it with a bright smile. Face: a small brown face, round and creased by smiling; deep laugh lines at the eyes and mouth; warm dark brown eyes, shining and a little tired; soft thin brows; a small nose with a sunburnt tip; a wide smiling mouth with a pale tint at the lips; a faint grey hollow under each cheekbone. Hair: grey-black, drawn into a plain low knot under a wide rice-straw hat tipped back on her head, the hat the largest shape at the top of the picture. Body: small, narrow-shouldered and slightly bent, standing with her skirt hem hitched. Clothing: a rite robe of hemp dyed deep leaf green, damp and darker at the hem, fine and well made, with wide sleeves and a crossed collar and a few lighter green stitches along one seam; grey hemp-silk beneath; the hem hitched up over bare legs muddy to the knee; at her belt a small round brown gourd. Hands and objects: the left sleeve is held up near her mouth; the right hand holds a long banner pole whose undyed hemp banner hangs behind her, painted with small round signs of the seasons, no writing. Background: a stepped hillside of flooded terraces catching the pink sky, soft mist among bamboo. Light: soft pink-gold dawn from the upper left, the water bright. Expression: a bright, kindly, creased smile with warm tired eyes, the cheeks a little hollow, a woman hiding her pain behind her welcome. A faint green and watery blue mist round her sleeves.

people.imagined: The gate of the abbey at midday, with the posted price board behind him. He sits on a stool counting beads quickly with one hand while chatting pleasantly, as he always does with a buyer.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a small table at the abbey gate, flicking the beads of an abacus with one hand while smiling warmly at a buyer just out of frame. Face: a plump round clean-shaven face, soft double chin; fair smooth skin; round cheeks pink and shiny; small bright intelligent eyes, lively and shrewd under neat brows; a short soft nose; a small pleasant mouth with a generous smile; a shaved head. Body: plump, round-shouldered and comfortable, short arms. Clothing: the grey hemp-silk robe of the abbey, finer than most, spotless and neatly pressed, with a crossed collar; the sleeves wide, one sleeve with the end of a small abacus showing from inside it; a broad dark sash. A black rain cloak is not worn. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on a wooden abacus on the table, the fingers poised on the beads; the left hand is raised in a gesture of welcome, palm up, soft and unmarked by work. A round bronze seal with twenty-four small marks around its edge lies by his elbow. Background: the abbey gate in blurred bamboo and an empty wooden board hung on a post, blank. Light: clean warm daylight from the upper left, a soft gloss on his bald head. Expression: friendly, reasonable, quietly calculating. A faint green-brown tint.

people.imagined: Terrace at harvest. He is on one knee in his good boots holding up a spirit-rice head to the light, counting the grains with his thumb. He is thinking of the sacks that will run out by autumn and smiling anyway.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at the edge of a golden terrace, holding up a single heavy head of rice against the sky and smiling at it. Face: a tall man's long sunburnt face with a strong chin; skin warm brown and creased at the eyes; thick even brows; calm brown eyes; a straight nose; a wide kind mouth with a closed smile; a short neat beard with a few threads of grey; a faint worry line between the brows. Hair: black, tied in a neat top-knot with a plain green cord, no hat. Body: tall, broad-shouldered, long-limbed, crouched on one knee. Clothing: the abbey's grey hemp-silk robe, neatly kilted to the knee for the terrace, clean; tucked in under it good pale linen trousers; and on his feet a pair of fine tall black leather boots, a landlord's boots, polished and the most surprising thing in the lower frame. A strip of green cloth round the right wrist. Hands and objects: the left hand, large and coarse with farmer's calluses, is spread on his knee; the right holds a rice head, heavy with pale gold-green grain. Background: rows of golden stepped terraces falling away to a misty plain, a small stone granary. Light: bright warm harvest light from the upper left. Expression: gentle, proud, quietly worried. A soft green-gold glow in the grain.

people.imagined: A dry night in the Thu Trì market, with the first drops of the rain she has just called starting on the lamp-lit stones. She stands in her black rain cloak with a wine cup, looking up at a window above the stalls she would like to rent.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a night market in her black rain cloak, a small wine cup in one hand, looking up past the viewer at an upper window while the first drops fall on her hood. Face: a long pale face, high cheekbones and a narrow chin; skin cool and fine; sharp dark brows with an arch; large dark eyes, a little tired and amused, heavy-lidded; a long straight nose; a wry mouth with one corner lifted, lips stained with wine; a tiny rain-drop at the end of the nose. Hair: black and glossy, loose over one shoulder and wet, the rest under a deep hood of black cloth. Body: tall, long-limbed, easy slouch, one hip cocked. Clothing: a long hooded rain cloak of fine black waxed silk, glistening wet, thrown open over a plain neat grey hemp-silk robe of the abbey, the grey the only abbey sign left; a loose belt of plain cord. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a small white wine cup with a thin rim; the left hand pushes back the hood edge; at her wrist a thin cord of green beads. Background: blurred paper lanterns in red and gold, wet dark stalls, silver threads of fine rain against the lights. Light: warm lantern light from the upper right with a cool blue rim from the left. Expression: lazy, sly, wanting something out of reach. Faint blue-green water mist round her.

people.imagined: In the herb gardens at dusk. A visitor has offered a hand and she has taken it in both of hers and lifted it to her nose, eyes closed, quietly reading it. She has not said a word yet.
people.subject: The moment: in a herb garden at dusk, she is holding a stranger's outstretched hand in both of hers, bending to sniff it with her eyes closed. Face: a gentle, plain, rounded face; skin tan and a little weathered; lashes lowered on the cheeks; soft brows; a small broad nose slightly wrinkled and drawn forward in the act of sniffing, the main thing; a soft closed mouth; a small leaf-shaped scar on the chin. Hair: brown, neatly braided and coiled low at the nape, a sprig of green mint behind the ear. Body: slender, a little stooped, hands always busy. Clothing: the abbey's grey hemp-silk robe, clean and kilted, a pale apron of undyed cloth with big pockets filled with sprigs; sleeves rolled; a green cord belt with a small gourd hanging from it. Hands and objects: her two hands cup a stranger's hand, brown and pale, in the middle of the frame, her thumb on the wrist; bunched dry herbs poke out of an apron pocket. Background: neat beds of herbs under a low sky, hanging bunches drying on a rope, soft purple dusk. Light: soft violet dusk light from the upper left. Expression: absorbed, kind, reading what she smells. A faint green aura of leaves.

people.imagined: In the grove after a storm. He has just cut a struck pole and stands with the saw in his right hand and the left hand held up, the missing ring finger toward the viewer. A plume of green cane smoke curls from a small fire beside him.
people.subject: The moment: in a bamboo grove after a storm, holding up his left hand with the missing ring finger, a drawn-out smile of satisfaction on his face. Face: a lean, dark, shrewd face, cheeks hollow; skin brown with smoke stains; narrow eyes that slide sideways; thin, slanted brows; a long nose; a thin lip curling; a small gap in the grin; one tooth in front is chipped. Hair: black, tied up under a wrapped green cloth, a few damp strands stuck to the forehead. Body: lean, long-armed and wiry, coiled like a spring, standing with a light, ready weight on his toes. Clothing: a plain grey hemp-silk robe of the abbey, kilted to the knee, clean but smoke-darkened along one sleeve; leather bracers; sandals of bamboo fibre. Hands and objects: the left hand is held up at the shoulder, the fingers spread, with the ring finger missing at the knuckle, plainly visible; the right hand holds a small curved saw with a pale handle and a fresh green pole with a scorched black band. Background: a bamboo grove after a storm, tall lightning-scarred bamboo, black split canes on the wet ground, a curl of green smoke rising, a few white flashes still in the clouds beyond. Light: pale dusky light from the upper left with a faint green flicker along the scorched cane. Expression: a slow, sly, satisfied smile with the narrow eyes sliding sideways, pleased with himself and giving nothing away. A faint green-white spark at the cane.

people.imagined: Evening on the terraces. He is walking back with a shin bandaged for the third time this month, looking at the empty far hill where the Bell Tower stands. He squints toward it and smiles at nothing.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a terrace in the evening, squinting into the bright distance toward a tower out of frame, a white bandage on his shin. Face: a sun-reddened, open, boyish face; eyes narrowed to slits as if still staring at something bright; wide cheekbones, a snub nose; thin brows pushed together by the squint; a gentle half smile; a small bruise on the left cheekbone. Hair: dark and untidy, tied with a cord, a few stalks of straw stuck in. Body: tall, thin and slightly clumsy, long-armed, standing on a stone terrace with the weight on his good leg. Clothing: the abbey's grey hemp-silk robe, kilted to the knee, neat; a rice-straw hat hanging on his back; under it mud-coloured trousers; the right shin wrapped in a thick white bandage, the main mark. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a long bamboo pole slung on his shoulder; the left hand lifts to shade the eyes. Background: flooded terraces reflecting a low sun in long bands of gold, a single distant tower on a hill, a bamboo fence along the terrace edge and a pair of white egrets in the water. Light: low gold sun in his face from the upper left. Expression: a dazzled, patient, open look, the eyes narrowed to slits against the glare and the mouth in a gentle half smile, a boy who does not mind being made to wait. A faint green tint of young rice.

people.imagined: At the planting dance, her mouth wide open in a loud laugh, the gap of two missing back teeth showing, one hand on another girl's shoulder in a way that is a little too heavy.
people.subject: The moment: laughing loudly at a planting festival, her mouth wide open and the gap of two missing back teeth on one side showing, one hand pressed hard down on a girl's shoulder at the frame's edge. Face: a broad, bright, ruddy face; round cheeks, dimpled; wide dark eyes, very bright and a little hard; strong black brows; a snub nose; the open laughing mouth with the visible gap at the back left, drawn large; a glint of cruelty under the fun. Hair: black, in two thick pigtails tied with scarlet cord, one flung forward. Body: strong, broad-shouldered and stocky, a farm girl, leaning toward the shoulder under her hand. Clothing: the abbey's grey hemp-silk robe, clean and kilted high; sleeves pushed up; a bright red cord belt; a string of dried red seeds round the neck. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted in a drumming gesture; the left presses on another girl's shoulder, only partly visible at the edge of the frame, the knuckles whitening. Background: green seedlings in muddy water, a line of singers in grey, blurred, a flag of coloured cloth on a pole, and a pale, warm sky over the hills. Light: bright cheerful midday light from the upper left. Expression: a loud, joyous, wide-open laugh with the bright eyes a little hard, a glint of cruelty under the fun. A faint green light.

people.imagined: A river bank at sunrise. He is in the middle of explaining his plan for the new isle and has lost the sentence, staring at the horizon where the mud isle shows, his rope-scarred hand lifted and pointing.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a river bank at sunrise, one hand pointing out across the water, eyes drifting to a far horizon mid-sentence. Face: a long, eager, tanned face; bright dark eyes set far away; strong brows lifted; a prominent nose; a mouth half open on a word he has forgotten; rope scars drawn on both hands. Hair: black, in a short tail tied with a bit of cord, a river reed behind the ear. Body: tall, lean, and restless, leaning forward. Clothing: the abbey's grey hemp-silk robe, clean and kilted, a coil of rope hung from a shoulder; a green cord belt. The grey hemp-silk robe is kilted to the knee with a green cord, the sleeves pushed back above rope-scarred forearms; a flat straw hat hangs on his back by a string and a water gourd bumps at his hip. His bare feet are caked with river mud, his toes spread wide on the wet bank, and the wind flattens the robe against his long thin frame. Hands and objects: both hands show a row of pale, thick rope scars across the knuckles; the right points; the left grips the rope coil. Background: a wide shining river, a low dark isle of wet mud in the distance with a few birds. Across the water, the new isle is a low dark smear of wet silt crowned with a few reeds and birds; nearer in, a hired boat is drawn up on the shingle, a half-coiled line of knotted rope lies beside it, and wisps of mist rise off the river in the early light. Light: bright golden sunrise from the upper left over the water. Expression: a dreamy, hungry, far-off look, the eyes pulled to something beyond the horizon and the lips a little parted, as if listening to a call only he can hear. A faint watery green.

people.imagined: Night on a Thu Trì street. She carries a heavy pack of rain-caller's poles on her shoulders and follows a black-cloaked woman through the market, unhappy, her eyes scanning the lamps.
people.subject: The moment: walking through a night market with a heavy bundle of long poles on her shoulders, scowling a little at the lamps. Face: a broad, honest tan face with a clear pale sunburn line across the nose that has never faded, a straight stripe; steady grey-brown eyes, cautious; strong straight brows; a wide mouth turned down; sturdy chin. Hair: brown, plaited and wound round the head, a grey cloth band across the forehead. Body: broad-shouldered and strong from a ferry pole, solid and upright; beneath the straps her shoulders look almost as wide as her hips, the widest thing in the frame. Clothing: the abbey's grey hemp-silk robe, clean and kilted, tied up at the hip with a faded blue ferry-rope belt, the sleeves rolled above forearms ropy from the pole; sturdy leather straps cross the chest holding the load; a woven straw hat dangles at her back; sturdy wet boots. Hands and objects: both hands steady a bundle of pale bamboo poles tied with cord across her shoulders; her palms are broad, hard and callused where they grip the bundle. Background: Around her the lantern-lit lane is crowded with stalls selling dyed cloth, steaming bowls and paper charms, a black-cloaked woman's shape moving ahead of her through the crowd, and rain-slick cobbles reflecting the lamps in long red and gold streaks. Light: warm lantern light from the upper right. Expression: a wary scowl at the lamps, the wide mouth turned down and the grey-brown eyes steady and watchful, a woman patient with the load and unhappy with the place. A faint blue-green of river mist.

people.imagined: Mid-morning on the terraces. He sits on a dyke with a bamboo shoot in his fist and an easy grin, one trouser leg rolled up higher than the other, while someone else's row is being weeded beside him.
people.subject: The moment: sitting lazily on a terrace dyke with a fresh bamboo shoot in his hand, grinning broadly. Face: a round, easy, sunburnt face; heavy-lidded merry eyes; sleepy brows; a flat wide nose; a big loose grin; a small cut on the chin. Hair: messy brown, a straw hat pushed back on his head, a few bamboo-sheath hairs caught on the sleeves. Body: soft, round-shouldered and relaxed, sprawled with one knee up and the other leg straight, leaning back on his left elbow with his belly loose, the round face turned up to the sun; his feet are bare and muddy. Clothing: the abbey's grey hemp-silk robe, clean, the sleeves covered with pale gold bamboo-sheath fuzz; one trouser leg rolled to the knee, the other down to the ankle. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up a pale conical bamboo shoot with brown scales; the left holds a leaf-wrapped rice ball; a woven basket half-full of shoots sits by his hip with a few brown scales fallen on the grass. Background: Below him the terrace steps fall away in bands of flooded green, a bent figure weeding a row is blurred in the lower right, bamboo groves frame the hill's crest, and a thin plume of smoke from the abbey kitchen rises against the pale blue morning sky. Light: warm mid-morning light from the upper left. Expression: a big, loose, sleepy grin with the heavy lids half down, a boy perfectly content to let the day go by. A faint green.

people.imagined: A remembered portrait of the founder as she first called rain on the bamboo hill, her arms raised to a pale sky, a sea-coast woman among the farmers.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder at fifty, arms raised, calling rain on a bare bamboo hill in drought. Face: a lean weathered coastal face, high cheekbones, brown from sea-spray; deep calm lines; dark intense eyes looking up; strong straight brows; a narrow nose; a firm mouth slightly open in a chant. Hair: black streaked with grey, hanging loose and windblown, a string of white shells at the temple. Body: tall, spare and straight, standing on a rock with her back arched and arms flung wide. Clothing: a plain sea-blue hemp rite robe, fine and clean, with long sleeves falling from her raised arms, a pale crossed collar and a sash of woven grey cord; bare feet on the stone. Hands and objects: both arms raised wide, the palms open to the sky; a long hemp banner painted with small round season signs, no writing, hangs from a pole behind her. Background: a pale dry sky with one distant dark cloud, a bare bamboo hill, cracked paddy earth below and small figures of farmers kneeling in rows, their faces turned up. Light: dry, pale light from the upper left, the cloud edged faintly with grey. Expression: a fervent, steady, generous look with the dark eyes lifted to the cloud and the firm mouth open in a chant. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint sea-blue tint.

people.imagined: A remembered portrait of the grain keeper in the dry winter of 1186, at the grove, holding the rite pole upright with all his strength, mist weak above him.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a grain keeper of fifty-five holding a rite pole upright with both hands in the dry winter, his face lifted to a pale sky, drawn with effort. Face: a thin, honest face, pale and lined; thick grey brows drawn together; eyes of mild brown lifted upward, steady; a narrow nose; a firm, slightly open mouth; a short grey beard, neat; sweat at the temple. Hair: grey, pinned neatly in a small topknot with a bamboo pin. Body: thin, upright, shoulders braced. Clothing: the abbey's grey hemp-silk robe, clean, with a green cloth sash; his sleeves are pulled back to the elbow. The grey hemp-silk robe is plain and clean, with a pale green sash knotted in a neat flat knot and a second thin cord at the wrist; the grain-keeper's small bone abacus bead hangs from his belt. His thin hands are stretched out and shaking slightly on the pole, the tendons standing in the wrists, and a vein throbs at his temple. Hands and objects: two thin hands grip a tall pale bamboo pole, the knuckles white; a few strips of green cloth tied at its top. Background: Behind him the winter grove is a dense wall of black-green bamboo with a few frost-white stalks, the ground bare and cracked, a small pale cloud hanging uselessly above the tallest canes, and two quiet figures kneeling at the edge with bowls held up. Light: cold grey light from the upper left. Expression: a devout, strained look held calm, the eyes fixed upward on the pole and the mouth steady, a stiff stillness over a deep worry. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A trace of green-grey.

people.imagined: At the rite ground, in the hush before the abbess begins. She stands holding the pole upright with her hands calloused, lips moving in a whispered count of breaths, her eyes on her mistress.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a rite ground holding a tall pole, whispering a count of breaths, eyes fixed on someone just out of frame. Face: a calm, pale, oval face; steady grey-brown eyes, full of watchful kindness; level brows; a small straight nose; lips moving mid-count; a few fine lines at the eyes. Hair: fine black, smoothed back and knotted low with a plain bamboo pin, a loose lock resting at her cheek. Body: medium height, composed, upright and quiet, with a stillness that makes her seem taller; her thumb marks a count against the pole and her breath makes a faint pale cloud in the cool air. Clothing: the abbey's grey hemp-silk robe, clean, with narrow cuffs turned back twice and a pale green sash; a small paper packet of pills peeks from her sleeve. Hands and objects: both palms held open toward the viewer near the pole, each crossed by two thick horizontal calluses, drawn plainly. Background: At the far side of the circle, out of focus, the abbess's small figure in a green robe stands with her arms lifted; the rite ground is ringed with a dozen pale poles, each topped with a green rag, the earth swept smooth, and a line of bamboo hills dissolving in morning haze. Light: soft pale light from the upper left. Expression: an attentive, tender look, the lips moving through the count and the grey-brown eyes warm with watchful kindness. A faint green-grey.

people.imagined: In the grove at noon, hearing someone laugh about bells. He has gone red and has put his hand to the raw birthmark on his neck while his other fist rests on a barrel lid.
people.subject: The moment: in a grove at noon, rubbing a raw red bell-shaped birthmark on his neck with one hand while the other fist rests on a barrel lid, glaring. Face: a square, hard, sunburnt face; heavy dark brows pulled down; fierce dark eyes; a wide jaw clenched; a short thick nose; the birthmark on the left side of the neck, shaped like a small bell, red and raw, the thing the eye finds first. Hair: black, cropped short and rough. Body: thick-necked, strong, broad-shouldered, a hard stance. Clothing: the abbey's grey hemp-silk robe, clean, collar open to show the birthmark; sleeves pushed to the elbow; a green sash. A small hatchet hangs from his belt. Hands and objects: the left hand is clamped to the side of his neck; the right fist rests on a round wooden barrel lid with a crack across it. His shoulders are hunched and his neck thick, the jaw clenched so that the muscle shows below the ear; the red bell-shaped mark is the size of a thumb-print and rubbed raw at the edges. The right fist lies half-open on the lid, the knuckles split and scabbed, and the cracked wood radiates from the fist in dark lines. Background: Behind him, an open yard of cut bamboo piles with the bark peeling, a rain barrel with its lid missing, a broken pole on the ground, and two blurred novices at the edge pretending not to look; a thin line of light cuts through the grove. Light: harsh noon light from the upper left. Expression: a simmering, set-jawed scowl, the brows low and the nostrils tight, anger held down behind a hand pressed to the red mark on his neck. A faint metallic-white tint at the knuckles.

people.imagined: At a night market stall as a buyer approaches. She has slid her left hand with its blue-dyed middle finger into her sleeve while her face turns to a smile of welcome.
people.subject: The moment: smiling a smooth welcome at a buyer at a night stall while tucking her left hand away into her sleeve. Face: a sharp pretty oval face with a pointed chin; clever dark eyes with long lashes, bright; thin neat arched brows; a small straight nose; a practised smile, lips tinted plum; a tiny beauty mark at the left corner of her mouth. Hair: black, in a high smooth knot held by a silver pin shaped like a raindrop. Body: slim and graceful, quick, her smooth skin faintly flushed in the lantern light. Clothing: the abbey's grey hemp-silk robe, fine and close-fitted, with a light blue under-collar showing at the throat and a sash of blue-grey silk with a small silver clasp shaped like a raindrop; the right sleeve cut wide and draping gracefully, the left gathered close to hide the stained finger. Hands and objects: the left hand is half hidden in the sleeve, the middle finger deeply stained bright blue, visible; the right holds a small scroll-less bamboo tally stick. Background: The stall behind her is hung with indigo-dyed cloth in bolts and lengths of every shade of blue, a lantern of blue paper, a basin of water with a floating leaf, a buyer's broad back at the edge of the frame, and wet cobbles that shine under the lamplight. Light: warm lantern light from the upper right. Expression: a practised, charming smile with the long-lashed eyes bright and level, a welcome with a price behind it. A faint blue water haze.

people.imagined: In the herb beds at night with a lantern. He counts jars aloud, stammering, and then laughs a half beat late at nothing, quite sure someone is stealing.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at night in a herb bed with a lantern, counting sealed jars aloud, mouth caught on a hard sound. Face: a round, mild, earnest face; wide pale eyes looking slightly puzzled; thin faint brows; a soft nose; a mouth stuck half open on a stammer, a soft laugh coming too late; soil smudged on the cheek. Hair: brown and short, soil in it. Body: soft-shouldered and heavy-handed, crouched. Clothing: the abbey's grey hemp-silk robe, clean at the collar, soil on the knees; a green cloth apron. His grey hemp-silk robe has the knees muddied and the green cloth apron stained with sap; the sleeves are rolled unevenly. He grips the jar the way a child would hold a baby bird. Hands and objects: both hands hold a small clay jar sealed with wax; each fingernail packed black with soil; a row of four more jars in front of him. His hands are plump, steady and clumsy, every nail rimmed black, a smear of soil along the left cheek, and a tiny brown moth has settled on his shoulder. Background: Around him the herb beds stand in neat dark rows beneath a low moon, a bamboo fence with a lantern on a post, a basket of cut herbs, and the sealed jars lined in the grass in a row with their wax caps shining; a distant figure in the blur, a thin man in a monk's cap, seems to watch from the path. Light: small orange lantern light from the lower right. Expression: an earnest, slow, suspicious frown, the lips caught half-shaped on a hard sound and the eyes darting to the dark beyond the lantern. A faint green.

people.imagined: At the edge of the planting field, wet hair from the paddy water, she opens her mouth to sing and only shapes the words, her chipped tooth showing.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the edge of a planting field with wet hair, mouth open to sing but making no sound, her chipped front tooth showing. Face: a thin brown face, open and bright; dark wide eyes with a flicker of fear; arched brows; a small nose; an open mouth with one front tooth chipped diagonally, visible; wet cheeks. Hair: black hair soaked and clinging to her neck, a drip falling from a strand. Body: slight, shoulders narrow, throat pulled in. Clothing: the abbey's grey hemp-silk robe, kilted to the calf over wet linen trousers, clean but dark with water at the shoulders and back; a pale green belt come half undone and hanging. Hands and objects: one hand pressed lightly to her throat; the other pinches a bundle of seedlings tight, the collarbones sharp above it and a wet braid dripping onto the robe in a spreading stain. Background: On the field's far side a crowd of singers in grey stand in a long line with their mouths wide open, a drum on a stand, a bright flag of coloured cloth, rows of tender green seedlings in the water reflecting a pale sky, and the slender figure of a taller girl turning away. Light: bright clear light from the upper left. Expression: a wide, yearning, frightened look with the lips parted to sing and no sound coming, the dark eyes flickering with fear. A faint blue-green.

people.imagined: Before a storm in the grove. He stands barefoot with a bundle of cut poles on his shoulder, looking at the darkening sky, a streak of white in his hair standing out as the first thunder sounds.
people.subject: The moment: standing barefoot in a bamboo grove under a darkening sky, a bundle of cut poles on his shoulder, looking up at the first flash. Face: a lean, open, brown face; clear trusting eyes tipped up; level brows; a straight nose; a calm half-open mouth. Hair: black with a distinct streak of lightning-white at the left temple, large and plain; tied in a short tail. Body: wiry and lean, long-armed, steady, standing with his feet apart on the dark earth, toes gripping, the old white scars plain across both soles and ankles; the bundle of poles on his shoulder, each as long as two men and pale as bone with a scorched black band near the top. Clothing: the abbey's grey hemp-silk robe, clean and kilted high to the knee, with a green cord belt and a short saw at the hip; bare feet. Hands and objects: the right hand steadies the bundle of pale bamboo poles on the shoulder; the left holds a small curved saw. Background: a thicket of tall black-green bamboo bent in a rising wind, leaves flying, the ground strewn with split canes, a white lightning thread forking behind the clouds, and a thin figure farther in, the master, standing quite still among the stalks. Light: eerie grey-green storm light from the upper left. Expression: a calm, expectant, trusting look with the eyes tipped up and the mouth half open, unafraid of the flash. A faint white-gold spark in the air.
